title: Summer Workshops — Ceramics
source_quote: Haystack's summer workshops explore the intersections of craft, art, and design in broad and expansive ways. Nearly all of our workshops are designed for all levels of experience
evidence_sentence: The summer workshops page lists ceramics as one of the craft disciplines offered alongside firing-related shop fees including kiln firing.
evidence_quote: Shop Fees include supplies your faculty has ordered or provided. Depending on which workshop you are in, Shop Fees can include kiln firing, new glazes made for your workshop
summary: Haystack offers summer workshops in ceramics and other crafts for adults 18+. The 2026 general application closed; open call spots may be available. Shop fees include kiln firing costs.
how_to_join: Submit application through StarRez; open call available at registrar@haystack-mtn.org
cost_text: $1,575–$2,000 tuition per session; room and board additional
pay_text: Tuition includes room and board; shop fees for materials and kiln firing
